history.text: The ocean liner Queen Elizabeth 2, now out of service, docks in Dubai.
history.title: Queen Elizabeth 2

photo.title: File:Wredes passage November 2025 01.jpg
photo.caption: The Wrede passage (Finnish: Wreden pasaasi. Swedish: Wredes passage; also known as the "Old merchant alley", Finnish: Vanha kauppakuja, or the "Grandma tunnel", Finnish: Mummotunneli) is an entity formed by two stone buildings in Kluuvi, Helsinki, Finland
photo.creator: ArildV

culture.text: An unidentified hijacker named Vrillon, claiming to be the representative of the "Ashtar Galactic Command", takes over Britain's Southern Television for six minutes, starting at 5:12 pm.
culture.title: Southern Television broadcast interruption
culture.description: TV audio transmission hoax in southern England (1977)
